target_layout.evidence: ghidra_get_struct_layout(FixedPoolAllocator) reports size 32 and the field_18 offset used by the body.

mechanics.null_path: A null allocator returns null before any field access or callback.
mechanics.initialization: For a non-null allocator, write zero to offset 0x18, call InitializeCriticalSectionAndSpinCount(allocator, 10), and return the same allocator pointer.
mechanics.ignored_words: The direct caller pushes only the allocator pointer. The imported Ghidra signature showing size, name, and flags is contradicted by the live call site and the body reads neither word.

evidence.observation: Ghidra reports FixedPoolAllocator::Alloc with body range 0x00926100-0x0092611a and 12 instructions.
The body loads the first stack word, checks it for null, writes zero to [ESI+0x18], pushes 10 and the pointer, calls the imported initializer, and returns the pointer.
Ghidra reports one direct caller at 0x009274d0.
The sole direct call xref is 0x009274f1.
The only direct callee is InitializeCriticalSectionAndSpinCount.
The imported structure is 32 bytes and exposes field_18 at offset 0x18.

confidence.overall: high for the observed local mechanics; imported function identity is bounded
medium: whether the imported Alloc name denotes initialization rather than a different allocator entry point

unresolved_questions: The imported Alloc label may not be the source-level method name.
The concrete FixedPoolAllocator owner and the runtime critical-section state remain outside the local body.
The caller's later EnterCriticalSection and active-count increment are separate operations and are not folded into this function.
blockers: No runtime execution of the original allocator is available.
The external initializer is represented by a package-local port for focused model testing.
